FAQ

Questions, answered.

Everything you need to know about how Anna.I coordinates your household.

What services does Anna.I coordinate? +

Four household essentials: cleaning, laundry, aircon servicing, and handyman work. Each category has vetted vendors matched to your home type and schedule.

How is payment handled? +

Payment is held in milestone escrow before the job starts. It is released to the vendor only when the work is verified complete — with photo proof. You never pay upfront for work that does not get done.

How does Anna.I remember my preferences? +

When you register, you tell Anna.I your home type, schedule, and preferences once. Every booking carries that context forward — no re-explaining, no starting from scratch.

How are vendors vetted? +

Every vendor passes background checks and identity verification before joining the network. Performance is tracked over time, not just through one-off star ratings.

What if something goes wrong? +

Because payment stays in escrow until verified completion, you have leverage. If a job is incomplete or unsatisfactory, payment does not release until it is resolved. Anna.I mediates disputes.

Is Anna.I available outside Singapore? +

Anna.I is currently Singapore-only. We are built specifically for the Singapore home-services context — including local vendor networks, CASE consumer protection frameworks, and local payment rails.

Do I need to be at home for every job? +

No. Once Anna.I knows your home access and preferences, vendors can complete jobs while you are away. Photo verification confirms completion remotely.

How much does it cost? +

Registration is free. You pay per job, with prices quoted before work begins. Anna.I takes a small coordination fee included in the quoted price — no hidden charges.
